link.note: Will abstract (Pelletreau p. 46). Ruled out as Temperance Tuttle's father.

summary: Grandson of Bull Smith (John's 1C10R via Bull Smith); once a rival candidate as Temperance Tuttle's father, now ruled out.
bio: Will dated 25 Jul 1747, proved 7 Jan 1747 O.S. (i.e., 1748 N.S.), leaving £100 each to 'my daughters Temperance Anna and Hannah' when 21 (Pelletreau p. 46). His homestead passed down his male line and was still held in 1898 as the 'Dick 'Nezer Place' (p. 46 note). His widow Anna married Zephaniah Platt.
